adds.title: Nebraska Equal Opportunity Commission - August 2020 announcement
adds.summary: In August 2020 the Nebraska Equal Opportunity Commission applied the U.S. Supreme Court's ruling prohibiting LGBT employment discrimination to housing cases, establishing protection against housing discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity.

adds.title: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) guidance
adds.summary: Effective February 11, 2021, the Fair Housing Act prohibition on discrimination because of sex was enforced to include discrimination because of sexual orientation and gender identity, with HUD accepting, investigating, and enforcing jurisdictional complaints of anti-trans housing discrimination involving sale, rental, terms, conditions, and services, providing transgender persons federal protection against housing discrimination in Nebraska.
